snippet.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 12 | Official Announcement | Wishlist Now
snippet.description:
Available October 15th. Wishlist on Steam Now: https://jbgm.es/4waXtq3

The Research & Development team at Jackbox Games has been analyzing parties from human history, to better understand what made them so hilarious and fun.

To build the party of the future, we must learn from the past.
